findings.status: confirmed deterministic schema semantics; implementation handoff only
findings.problem: 把 strict machine schema 等同于无条件 additionalProperties=false，既可能禁止一个正确的组合闭合契约，也未指导 allOf/$ref 的闭合层级和消费端方言能力。

minimal_counterexample.schema_shape: Draft2020-12 allOf: base requires integer id and has additionalProperties=false; extension requires mode enum.
minimal_counterexample.observed: 合法 mode 被当作额外字段拒绝，错误为 Additional properties are not allowed ('mode' was unexpected)。

findings.expected_contract: 接受 id=1/mode=safe；拒绝未知 admin、缺 id、缺 mode、错误 id 类型和错误 mode 枚举。严格拒绝未知字段保持不变。
findings.minimal_fix: 在既有 Skill constraints/Workflow7 指明先固定 $schema/dialect、validator 版本和消费端 keyword 子集；同层 properties 使用 additionalProperties=false；allOf/$ref 组合在支持 2019-09/2020-12 的消费端可用外层 unevaluatedProperties=false，不能在可扩展子 schema 提前封闭；旧 draft/窄子集同层展开并保留 additionalProperties=false，无法表达则 needs-fix，不静默退为 permissive。将小型正负用例放入现有 reference，无新 Skill/Gate。
meaningful_acceptance: 直接运行实际 validator 验证同层闭合合法样本通过且全部五种非法样本拒绝。
保留 broken allOf 负对照，再验证组合闭合法满足同一输入契约。
Draft7 对 unsupported unevaluatedProperties 的负对照必须显示未知字段漏放；Draft7 flatten 修法满足同一契约。
从随包 reference 的实际示例提取并执行，结合 Skill 方言选择说明审查；关键词存在不作为方法有效性证据。

probe.scope: library semantics diagnostic only; no production ADK or model behavior claim

findings.preserved_success: 原有 strict/required/enum/refusal/parse-failure、安全授权、生命周期和未知字段拒绝不降级。

findings.status: confirmed published template defaults; no runtime bypass claimed
findings.problem: 默认随包 task package 连接的未填写 Completion Review 表，把五项检查均初始化为 pass，而 Evidence、Parent task、Owner 等全部为空；文本没有已完成示例声明。
findings.minimal_counterexample: 仅复制该待填模板、不运行任何验证，即获得包含 Verification commands ran=pass 等五项肯定结论且证据全空的报告。claude-code/opencode 实际导出均保留这五行，非失效文档。
findings.expected_contract: 未核验的空表只能 pending/not-run；得到实际范围/命令/快照证据后逐行填 pass；失败、阻塞或不适用需要对应真实状态/理由。模板本身不产生验证通过。
findings.minimal_fix: 只修改五个默认 Result 和一句按实证填写说明；可保持既有表格与字段，不新建 Gate、协议或单独审查流程。
meaningful_acceptance: 通过真实 export_assets 分别检查两个导出目标，解析默认 task package 的实际 checklist 链接。
解析 Completion Review 表行语义，所有初始行 evidence 为空时不得标 pass，且字段/项目数量保持。
有明确示例且具真实证据的通过记录可保留 pass，不全仓机械替换合法的已完成示例。

limitations: This is a complete file-level source review of the assigned 34 Skills, not proof of defect freedom or native model/runtime effectiveness.

The only executions were isolated local JSON Schema semantic probes and existing ADK export into disposable scratch directories; no native Skill discovery/load/trigger run, paid model A/B, live-device test, network mutation, commit, ref operation or external message was performed.
Source bytes and complete reading coverage do not measure Token use, latency, task success, precision/recall or product qualification.
External full downloaded bytes were Git-blob checked, but actual reading was intentionally limited to recorded full/excerpt ranges; source-author evaluation results were not independently reproduced.
The schema finding is a prescriptive-method gap, not an assertion that a current ADK production schema or runtime accepts/rejects the demonstrated payload.
The checklist finding is an unsafe initial document state, not evidence that a real reviewer or runtime gate has already accepted missing evidence.
